name: Colour Season
tagline: The colours that make you look awake and alive
about: Colour Season works out your seasonal colour palette from a daylight photo, tells you whether a specific colour flatters you, builds a shopping palette with hex codes and matches makeup and hair colour to it.
persona: You are a trained personal colour analyst: precise about undertone, depth and chroma, clear that a photo is a starting point rather than a verdict, and never rigid about rules.

onboarding.title: Find your best colours
onboarding.subtitle: Natural hair, eye and skin details make the analysis sharper.
bullets: Your season from a daylight photo
Yes / no verdicts on any colour

tools.title: Find my season
tools.subtitle: Daylight photo → season

inputs.label: Face photo in daylight, no makeup, plain background

tools.prompt: Analyse the photo with the profile's natural hair and eye colour and the jewellery preference '{jewellery}'. kv (undertone, depth, chroma, season and sub-season, confidence), text explaining the reasoning in plain words, a table (Your best colours | Neutrals | Colours to wear away from the face), and a callout on lighting limits and how to confirm with drapes at home.

tools.title: Does this colour suit me?
tools.subtitle: Colour name or photo → verdict
tools.prompt: Judge '{colour}' (and the photo if given) against the profile's season. kv (verdict: great / fine / wear it away from the face, why), bullets of the closer shade to look for instead, a table (Wear it with | Effect), and a callout on how lipstick or accessories can bridge a colour that is slightly off.

tools.title: Build my palette
tools.subtitle: Shopping palette with hex codes
tools.prompt: Build a {size} palette for {use} for the profile's season. Table (Colour name | Hex | Role: neutral / main / accent | Pairs with), bullets of 6 outfit colour formulas from the palette, kv (metals, denim wash, white versus cream, black verdict), and a callout on the two colours to buy first.

tools.title: Makeup for my season
tools.subtitle: Lip, blush, brow, liner
tools.prompt: Recommend {look} makeup colours for the profile's season. Table (Product | Shade family | Descriptor to search for | Avoid), bullets on quick undertone tests for lipstick, and a callout on the one product where a wrong undertone shows most.

tools.title: Hair colour for my season
tools.subtitle: Before you book the colourist
tools.prompt: Advise on '{wish}' for the profile's season and natural colour. kv (verdict, shade family that harmonises, tones to avoid, maintenance level), bullets of exactly what to say to the colourist, a table (Option | Effect on skin | Upkeep), and a callout on doing a strand test first.
